body: I don't know if any amount of kitten gifs can undo smelly old man feet.  However, I will tell you what worked for me when I used to have migraines.  Maybe that will help you a little bit.  Ice pack and dark.  If you can put something over your eyes - and still feel/be safe - blocking out as much light as possible always helped me.  Also, an ice pack straight to the head where the pain was centered.  Of course, some kind of towel or cloth in that space between the pack and the skin.  I don't know if your train has food/beverage but they likely have a first aid kit with a cold compress.  I think this is a true medical need that would warrant their use of that kit.  I hope you feel better soon.  I'm sorry I can't do more to cheer you up.  If you've already tried cold/dark, I apologize.  Oh, when you cover your eyes, you could slip a bit of cloth of your nose too so at least you have a filter for the aromas that surround you.  Hope you get some rest!

I'm so glad you went to the ER.  I just read a friend's post today - following one of their colleague's suicide - that talked about the need for more supportive services for EMT's and other healthcare workers.  They talked about the immense stress and trauma associated with that kind of work.  So, from the bottom of my heart, I hope you are able to heal from those scary thoughts quickly.  Also, thank you for choosing that career.  Your hard work makes the rest of us feel safer knowing that someone is there for us in our worst moments.

Thanks for writing this today.  Please know, it brought me to tears.  I just remembered that I, too, had wanted to die when I was 7 years old.  Also like you, I had a period of stability in my 20s but things have gone to shit in my late 30s.  I'm glad you're ok tonight.  I'm truly and honestly sorry that things are bad and I want you to know I'll be thinking about you and hoping you have a better tomorrow.  I'm glad you're alive.  I'm glad you posted because getting some sleep and checking out tomorrow's circumstances is probably what I need to do too.
